name: Password Authentication Session Establishment
summary: Legacy password-login binding that incorrectly reused the password-registration session-establishment transition.
notes: Deprecated during Password Sign In reconciliation. Use auth.flow.password-sign-in for password login.
auth.transition.password.establish-session remains registration-oriented and must not be used as the canonical password-login outcome.

sourceReferences.note: Password Sign In reconciliation separated login outcomes from the existing password-registration session transition.
